problems: The wheel (0.88 across) is almost as wide as the 1.0-tall tower is high, so the card reads as a big fan on a short stubby pedestal instead of a farm windmill on a tall tower. A real windmill wheel is about a quarter to a third of the tower's height.
The tower is two stacked blocks with an open seam and a ledge where they meet. It looks like two parts instead of one tapering tower. The fix uses one continuous taper with a band covering the joint.

The red tail vane, one of the card's hero colors, is almost entirely hidden behind the wheel. Only a small red sliver shows. The head housing and the boom are hidden too. At azimuth 28, with a wheel this large, the tail does not read.
The blade-widening warp uses fixed constants (0.16, 0.32) instead of the blade's real length, so the blade taper is off.

The tail vane is too small. At 0.28 by 0.2 it reads as a small red flag mostly hidden behind the wheel. On a farm windmill the vane is a large panel on a long boom, and the brief names it as one of the three main parts. Fix: make the vane bigger and lengthen the boom so the vane sits clear of the wheel.

The back hills render as a dark, flat-topped olive wall right behind the wheel. They squeeze the sky into a thin strip and look darker than the golden prairie. Fix: make the hills lower, lighter in color and farther back, so they read as soft, distant shapes.
